Being a foodie, I also love that Toronto has some of the best restaurants and cuisine from all over the world.  Harbourfront, where our condo is located, is a great combo of a calm retreat and an active main attraction!  The neighbourhood of Harbourfront is very touristic and recently underwent a huge and expensive construction facelift from granite cobbled sidewalks to a new bike/pedestrian path in front of our building extending across the lake, from east to west, over 20 km.   Our  bungalow in thé Danforth Village is steps away from shops and the subway where downtown is accessible in 15 minutes but also a quiet neighbourhood retreat. Our newly renovated house is calm and relaxing. Our Beaches House offers some of the best family experiences in the city. Steps away from the Beach and Lake, enjoy the hustle of the Queen St shops and restaurants and take the streetcar to Leslieville, Riverdale and Downtown all within 30 min or less. I ask is that Guests respect our property (which we take great pride in) and leave it as you found it.  I will do the same for any property I stay in!  As a guest, my favourite thing about AirBnB is I get to pretend I am local when I stay in someone's home.  It gives me a totally different perspective of the place I am visiting, one I find fascinating as we become part of the community!  Carpe diem!

Welcome to Qwest. This one bedroom plus den family friendly condo is great for staycation or as a work from home alternative. Qwest’s luxury condos in downtown Toronto are the setting for this one bedroom plus office den apartment at the heart of Canada’s most vibrant city.
This one-bedroom executive rental is CHBO Certified and offers you the best of everything.
At QWEST you’re greeted by an elegantly appointed lobby of marble, tile, and glass.
Inside the unit you have high-end furnishings of neutral beige and brown which compliments the blonde hardwood floors under spotlights. The open floor plan consists of living, dining, and kitchen in a long main living space. There’s a big screen Samsung ready for your shows, high speed Wi-Fi to entertain and inform, and a four-seat dining area perfect for friends. A kitchen of granite counters and matching new black appliances combines with all the tools and utensils for you to cook every night if you wish. A huge king bed of ultra-soft linens and a wall mounted flat screen TV is the perfect spot to indulge or get some rest. There is track lighting, a full closet, and it is just across from the full bathroom with a shower and tub combination. You also have a stacked washer and dryer combination, so it’s just a few steps to get your laundry done. There is underground visitor parking available for free for your guests or for you to park during the day. if you need overnight parking, please contact our office. Extra charges might apply.

A perfect 100 walk score means forget renting or buying a car. Get a bird’s eye view at CN Tower along the shoreline of Lake Ontario, have a seat at the retractable roofed Rogers Centre, home to baseball’s Toronto Blue Jays and Toronto Argonauts of the CFL, or tour Ripley’s Aquarium of Canada - all a 13-minute stroll away in the entertainment district. Hundreds of great restaurants of all cuisines are walkable from QWEST, along with bars and jazz clubs, museums, art galleries, and more. Hockey fans are in heaven here as well, it’s a 15-minute walk to see the Maple Leafs at the Air Canada Centre and even closer to the Hockey Hall of Fame. Or, get away from the hustle of downtown at one of a dozen city parks in walking distance from QWEST. At the end of the day, have a cocktail at Harbourfront Centre on the shore of the lake or charter a boat out onto the lake, and revel in all Toronto has to offer.

With hundreds of major employers and thousands of restaurants and shopping options within walking distance, this short-term rental offers both convenience and ambiance.

 (Hidden by Airbnb) , (Hidden by Airbnb) , AirBnB, and Salesforce have sales offices here, and tech companies near central Toronto include Pivotal, Connected Lab, Shopify, MyPlanet, 500Px, Influitive, EventMobi, Freshbooks, and Wattpad.
Travel nurses and doctors or patients from other cities can easily reach St. Michaels Hospital, The Hospital for Sick Children, Toronto General Hospital, Women’s College Hospital, and Toronto Western Hospital.
If city business brings you here, Toronto City Hall is a seven-minute walk. The Toronto Stock Exchange is the ninth largest stock exchange in the world. Finance is also a major economic driver with the Royal Bank of Canada, the Bank of Nova Scotia, Toronto Dominion Bank, and the Bank of Montreal all based here.
Osgood Hall and court houses at 361 University Ave., are within 5 minutes walking distance.
Canada Opera House, Sheraton Center and many other points of interest are within your most convenient reach.

We are a team of 4 Eastern Europeans and 4 Jamaicans from different professional backgrounds but with one common passion: their LOVE for Jamaica, that we would like to share with our guests. We formed a property management and tour company to help visitors of Jamaica to enjoy this lovely island by providing a top notch accommodations and unique experiences. We have lived in various countries and travelled to over 80 countries in the world. We know what's important for guests during their travels and try to arrange my apartments accordingly. We put a lot of love in passion in decorating and furnishing our places yet keeping prices reasonable. We hope we will get a chance to host you.

WHY and WHEN to stay with us:
1.  If you are concerned about safety. Jamaica has a high crime rate. Even though tourists are extremely unlikely to be the target of any violent crimes, some common accommodation can attract burglary and similar crimes of opportunity. ALL of our properties are located at VERY SAFE gated compounds and communities with 24/7 security or police station nearby.
2. If you need a good beach. All our properties are within walking distance to the beach. We also provide FREE Beach access to Hard Rock Cafe for properties located in that area. 
3.  If you are looking for a comfortable relaxing vacation with easy reach to multiple amenities. All our apartments are fully equipped with ALL the necessities, wi-fi, cable TV and air conditioning. Most of them offer access to the pool/beach and gym on the property.  We can provide other services: tours (3 of our members are certified tour guides), airport pick-ups, chef, cleaning, nanny, grocery shopping or delivery, driver, car rental. In addition, our properties are connected to the hotels and we are less likely to experience power outages that are very common in many other areas around the city. 
4.  If cleanliness is a must. We use professional cleaning services and personally check every property before you check-in.
5.  If you are booking in advance and are concerned that your host might cancel. Don’t worry, we are superhosts, which means we would never ever cancel a reservation unless in unlikely extraordinary circumstances outside of our control (e.g. flood).
6.  If you want privacy and a flexible host. We respond to most questions/concerns within an hour and we are committed to fix any issues in our control within the same day. We give our guests a lot of privacy (unless you ask otherwise), which means you can check-in any time after your check-in time and request later check-out. We try our best to be flexible and accommodate your all needs and requests.

When to look ELSEWHERE:
When you are looking for a full immersion in rural Jamaican experience or local culture (you sh
ould not be looking in Montego Bay for that anyway)
While we can give you a good taste of that (offer Jamaican meals, local tours, etc), our highest priorities are your comfort and confidence in safety, with properties centrally located in the developed areas ideally suited for a worry-free relaxing vacation.

Other things to note:
When choosing a location to stay in Montego Bay, remember that it is a small town, most places will appear to be close by to the beach and entertainment, however please do some research about the area you are considering. You can be 10 min away but up in the hills which is very difficult to reach by taxi with very bad roads and you would end up spending $30 on cabs each time you leave the property (there is no uber or taxi meters here, prices for tourists can be very high, some neighbourhoods are far less safe and walking at night can be strongly discouraged etc. Do your research first!

host_about:
Welcome Students & Travellers, 

A little bit about myself? I love meeting new people because every person you meet will always have a new story to tell and I love listening to them. I enjoy being in the outdoors, such as camping and hiking or relaxing at the cottage.

My family and I have traveled to near and far countries such as the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, England, Czech Republic, Budapest, Poland, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, Dubai, South Africa, Egypt, and many more places! Being a host allows me to mix all the great things about traveling and meeting new people of different backgrounds together and in the comfort of my own home. I have been a host for 4 years now to many learners and travellers from all around the world coming from Germany, Netherlands, England, Switzerland, Sweden, France, Israel, South Korea, Philippines, Vietnam, Russia Federation, Colombia, and Brazil, just to name a few! 

I must mention, I know a lot of you are moving to Canada for educational purposes, and I would like to say that my home is welcoming to learners. Needless to say, I would be happy to invite you to stay in my home. I have 4 bedrooms each room has a bed, a desk, and lots of closet space. I have 1.5 Gb high-speed internet and Netflix. Also, you would have access to three subway stations from our front door! High Park and Runnymede station take 6 minutes to arrive, where Jane station takes 5 minutes to arrive to from my home. With 30 minutes of travel you can reach English schools, George Brown College, Humber College, Toronto University, York University, and Ryerson University. Please don’t hesitate to ask me any questions! 

Let's always remember life is an adventure. Make new friends, and laugh a lot along the way. 

Hope to meet you soon!

host_about:

We clean up after ourselves and leave places the way we found them or tidier, whether it is a camp site, our extended family's lakefront cottage, or someone's home we are privileged to visit.

As a family we have lived in Washington DC, Berkeley CA, and now Toronto.  We love to take advantage of all the museums and diverse cultures (especially the food!) that have been on our doorstep in DC, SF, and now Toronto.

All of us play a musical instrument and participate in sports or dance. I also have a particular interest in design and architecture, and especially like to visit structures by Frank Lloyd Wright and other great architects.  My favorite museum in the world is the V&A in London, and my favorite trumpet player is Clifford Brown.

host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. I've also been complimented on my knack for home design and couple that with being slightly OCD and my years of landlord experience, I feel I'm able to provide the settings that I have always loved and remembered in my own personal travels. I have moved into a very large home right across from Woodbine Beach where I have already had very positive hosting experiences right from the get-go! 

The location, home and decor is not only premium but I pay careful attention to detail is what I hope will resonate with my guests. My friends and family have referred to my new home as the Bougie Beach House and that has been coined as one of Toronto's best beach AirBnB's!

host_about:
I am a fun loving and easy going girl who moved to Toronto from Vancouver a few years back to build a family with my wonderful partner Allyson.  We have two beautiful kids and when we aren't adventuring at beaches or local hiking spots, we are trying to remember what sitting silently on a sunny patio sipping a craft IPA feels like.   
We renovated this house a few years ago and are thrilled to share it with like-minded travellers who want to enjoy what Toronto has to offer, but also want to live like a local in a "real" neighbourhood.

We picked this neighbourhood because of the vibe - on the verge of becoming trendy, but solidly holding on to the old-school roots.  We are sandwiched between Corso Italia and Little Jamaica, with plenty of modern restaurants sprinkled throughout.  

We love trying local wines and beers, so if that interests you please let us know.   We also love being a tourists in our own city so if you're looking for fun things to do or the best restaurants to eat at we would be more than happy to compile a list for you.

We hope you enjoy our place as much as we do! Happy travels!

About us: Jocelyn works for a non-profit that works with at-risk young people in Scarborough. Allyson works at a university think-tank that makes homelessness research accessible and practical for social service organizations.

host_about:
Hi there, my name is Mari. I am a former food magazine publisher and obsessed foodie. I have taught and written about cooking experiences for many years. 


I have travelled to Italy many times and one of my favourite experiences was squeezing into the small kitchen of locals, eating at their table, enjoying amazing simple homemade food, and sharing stories with people from around the world. 


I always say Toronto is a place where at any time one can look around and see diversity in cultures all around. I love that. I would rather eat an ethnic hole in the wall than a fancy restaurant. Of course only if the food is fabulous!


Toronto is a city to discover, a cultural melting pot, and everywhere you look you have extraordinary things to see. A two-faced city, glamorous and gritty, powerful and humble, noisy and quiet, with glittering skyscrapers reflecting the golden light of the sun, and all of it wrapped up in the serenity of Lake Ontario.


My neighbourhood, a once Polish neighbourhood, surrounded by the magnificent High Park and moments from the lake, spectacular multi-storey red brick homes, inches apart, on tree-lined streets. A main street filled with butchers and bakers and specialty shops and boutiques displaying their wares. Neighbours know neighbours and shop owners seem to know everybody’s name, connecting the entire neighbourhood with a beautiful community vibe.

Our home features three bedrooms, each with a comfortable bed and plenty of storage space for your belongings. The master bedroom has a king size bed, while the second two bedrooms have queen sized beds. All the bedrooms have 
access to a shared bathroom with a shower. Fresh linens and towels are provided for all guests.

The living room is a great place to kick back and relax after a long day of exploring. It features a comfortable couch and armchair and flat-screen TV with cable and internet. There is also a dining area with a table and chairs, perfect for home-cooked meals or takeout from one of the local restaurants.

host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. host_about:
Hello!

My name is Jonathan and I would love to be your gracious host!

A little about myself: I love to travel and when I'm not traveling I enjoy going to community-oriented, transformational festivals.

In 2012, I returned from a 4-month, whirlwind tour of South-East Asia where I backpacked 6 countries: Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Laos, and Cambodia. In 2013, I backpacked Vietnam.

I like to participate in festivals, both local and international. They are an avenue which enables me to create art, experience music, and celebrate life. I've been to Burning Man three times! )'(

I am grounded, emotionally sound, positively driven, and; neither a neat freak nor a slob. I am an individual who is independent, inclusive and socially/community oriented. Most of all, I am responsible, laid-back, and fun!

I will never discriminate, nor hold any prejudices towards any guest based on race, colour, religion, or creed.
I'm open to all genders, identities, and sexual orientations.
I will give each and every interested guest a fair chance to stay despite being a new user or having a lack of positive reviews.


I have acted as a host at previous house shares and my other roommates can attest to the fact that I will provide superb hospitality. 

I've graduated from Toronto's Ryerson University in Hospitality and Tourism and have worked at prestigious hotels such as the Fairmont Royal York in Toronto and the Fairmont Banff Springs in Alberta.

It has been a dream of mine to run a small B&B and will strive to ensure engaging service and attention to detail to elevate each stay into a cherished memory.

host_about:
Hi! My name is Maria. I have lived in my big, beautiful Georgian Revival home for 27 years. Six years ago I underpinned (lowered the floor in) my basement and created a beautiful, eco-friendly, modern, one bedroom apartment--waiting for YOU to enjoy!

Until this renovation took over my life, I was working on a Master's degree at York University in the Faculty of Environmental Studies. My topic is Indigenous food sovereignty. Don't know what that is? I'd be happy to tell you. I love school and can't wait to get back to my studies since I took a leave to complete your home away from home.

I have been working for our national public broadcaster, the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (CBC), for 26 years as a video editor in TV News. I am a news junkie! I love political and social justice discussions. I have a Specialist Social Cultural Anthropology/Major Sociology/Minor Portuguese undergraduate degree from the University of Toronto.

I am an avid gardener and member of the Horticultural Societies of Parkdale and Toronto. I garden at home and in an allotment garden nearby in High Park. I also have a certificate in Baking and although I didn't end up working in the field, I can and love to bake up a storm! Depending on my work schedule and how long you stay, I promise to share with you if I bake! And if you're visiting Toronto to celebrate something special in your life, if time allows, I can make you something special, per your request.

I love traveling, especially to my small stone house on the Island of Pico in the Azores where I was born. I have also travelled in Brazil, Mexico, various Caribbean islands, the Eastern and Western U.S., England, Germany, Switzerland, Portugal, Nepal, and India. I love meeting and learning about new cultures, as opposed to resort holidays. I also lived in Sonoma County, California for two years.

I hope to host you soon!

...../Maria

host_about:
I'm just a typical gay Irish Ukrainian guy from Northern Ontario long established in the multicultural metropolis of Toronto – a place that the travel writer Jan Morris once characterized, not unkindly as “the second best prize in life”.  I’ve lived here for over three decades and find myself still energized by the city's incredibly diverse, surprisingly harmonious, culturally explosive, constantly changing urban environment---and not one characterized by geography or architecture but by the quietly courteous, creative people who live here and the enticing energy of a great city in the making where there is room for everyone (or at least it seemed that way until the place attained critical mass for explosive real estate values in the past few years). 

I've lived in the weird and wonderful Kensington Market for almost 25 years and feel like the place has become a part of me and vice versa.  I read a lot and my house is anchored by overflowing book shelves with a pretty good focus on Toronto titles and Canadian authors (One of my former classmates, just won the pre-eminent Canadian literary award for his novel Bellevue Square – on which my house is located).   The house also houses many mementoes of my family and business including two Emmy Awards.  It has been a key setting for my adult life and has served as a bakery (in its prior life) as well as as a film production office, performance space and site of many birthday events, several weddings and one memorable memorial service.   I love entertaining here and take great pride in my delightful duty of introducing Toronto through my eyes and experiences to new friends from around the world. 

Bienvenue a tous.   J’espere d’avoir bientot l’honneur de vous acceuillir chez moi et de vous presenter Toronto, ma ville.

host_about:
I'm just a typical gay Irish Ukrainian guy from Northern Ontario long established in the multicultural metropolis of Toronto – a place that the travel writer Jan Morris once characterized, not unkindly as “the second best prize in life”.  I’ve lived here for over three decades and find myself still energized by the city's incredibly diverse, surprisingly harmonious, culturally explosive, constantly changing urban environment---and not one characterized by geography or architecture but by the quietly courteous, creative people who live here and the enticing energy of a great city in the making where there is room for everyone (or at least it seemed that way until the place attained critical mass for explosive real estate values in the past few years). 

I've lived in the weird and wonderful Kensington Market for almost 25 years and feel like the place has become a part of me and vice versa.  I read a lot and my house is anchored by overflowing book shelves with a pretty good focus on Toronto titles and Canadian authors (One of my former classmates, just won the pre-eminent Canadian literary award for his novel Bellevue Square – on which my house is located).   The house also houses many mementoes of my family and business including two Emmy Awards.  It has been a key setting for my adult life and has served as a bakery (in its prior life) as well as as a film production office, performance space and site of many birthday events, several weddings and one memorable memorial service. host_about:
I enjoy history, and have the pleasure of residing in the same house and community my great grandparents moved into: a house that has witnessed six generations of laughter and love.     

My family always practiced the old tradition of having a place at the dinner table for guests, and always welcomed visitors. I’m proud to continue that tradition in the context of Airbnb, welcoming people to my community and offering a hospitable place for them to lay their head for the night.
 
As your host, I can take you on a tour of my neighbourhood or simply suggest places to visit. If you like eating out, I can direct you to either the most exciting new restaurants or the long-established eateries loved by members of our community.  

I enjoy working with my hands, refurbishing old artifacts. I also enjoy gardening and outdoor activities. I watch documentaries, read scientific articles and visit galleries and museums…and I’m always happy to assist visitors as they discover Toronto.  

When I have traveled, I always enjoyed interacting with the people from those places and visiting historical sites. I recall sitting in a pub in a very ancient town once, where one wall was part of an old Roman wall!  It’s my pleasure to welcome you to a part of Toronto’s history, in this beloved century home.

Whether you are visiting Toronto to study, work, or explore. I think our home is a great fit for just about anybody. If you enjoying going out for dinner, drinks, movies, or playing volleyball out the beach, please drop us a line. We're often out and about doing fun things.

Adventure is something that defines us, and we strongly believe that the world is too beautiful to be left undiscovered! 

If you need any help discovering Toronto or any assistance while here, just let us know. We'll try our best to help accommodate you. ;)

Seiko & Shanny

See you soon,
Joanna & Tim.

host_about:
We are the owners of this beautiful home. Our property is a labour of love. We enjoy taking care of it and making it available to guests from around the world. We've had the pleasure of hosting guests from so many places, including Ireland, England, Scotland, Egypt, Germany, France, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Nova Scotia, Nunavut, Quebec, New York, Connecticut, Michigan, Texas, California, North Carolina, Ohio, Florida, Colorado, Kentucky, Hong Kong, Kenya, India, Mexico, Australia, Singapore Slovakia, Ukraine, Israel and The Bahamas. It's been a treat getting to know all of these wonderful people and helping them have a pleasant stay at the house. We love to do gardening....our profile photo was taken in our garden on a warm, bright summer night with a full moon.

We love the quiet, friendly neighbourhood (with many original owners). The privacy and peacefulness of the backyard with all the lush greenery is so relaxing. The layout of the house, with bright windows all around is also very appealing. While sitting on the deck, you feel like you're out in the country. If you enjoy cooking, there's a lovely herb garden in the backyard with a variety of fresh seasonings. 

The location of this property is great because it's close to the main highway so you can get around quickly by car. You can also use public transit...the bus stop is right around the corner. Travel in any direction to get to shops, restaurants, movie theatres and other attractions. The Toronto Zoo is just a 10 minute drive from the house and all of the major attractions are located within 30 minutes from the house. There's plenty to see and do in downtown Toronto and all around the city. Whatever the purpose of your trip, you will enjoy the comfort of this home!

Welcome to Qwest. This one bedroom plus den family friendly condo is great for staycation or as a work from home alternative. Qwest’s luxury condos in downtown Toronto are the setting for this one bedroom plus office den apartment at the heart of Canada’s most vibrant city.
This one-bedroom executive rental is CHBO Certified and offers you the best of everything.
At QWEST you’re greeted by an elegantly appointed lobby of marble, tile, and glass.
Inside the unit you have high-end furnishings of neutral beige and brown which compliments the blonde hardwood floors under spotlights. The open floor plan consists of living, dining, and kitchen in a long main living space. There’s a big screen Samsung ready for your shows, high speed Wi-Fi to entertain and inform, and a four-seat dining area perfect for friends. A kitchen of granite counters and matching new black appliances combines with all the tools and utensils for you to cook every night if you wish. A huge king bed of ultra-soft linens and a wall mounted flat screen TV is the perfect spot to indulge or get some rest. There is track lighting, a full closet, and it is just across from the full bathroom with a shower and tub combination. You also have a stacked washer and dryer combination, so it’s just a few steps to get your laundry done. There is underground visitor parking available for free for your guests or for you to park during the day. if you need overnight parking, please contact our office. Extra charges might apply.

A perfect 100 walk score means forget renting or buying a car. Get a bird’s eye view at CN Tower along the shoreline of Lake Ontario, have a seat at the retractable roofed Rogers Centre, home to baseball’s Toronto Blue Jays and Toronto Argonauts of the CFL, or tour Ripley’s Aquarium of Canada - all a 13-minute stroll away in the entertainment district. Hundreds of great restaurants of all cuisines are walkable from QWEST, along with bars and jazz clubs, museums, art galleries, and more. Hockey fans are in heaven here as well, it’s a 15-minute walk to see the Maple Leafs at the Air Canada Centre and even closer to the Hockey Hall of Fame. Or, get away from the hustle of downtown at one of a dozen city parks in walking distance from QWEST. At the end of the day, have a cocktail at Harbourfront Centre on the shore of the lake or charter a boat out onto the lake, and revel in all Toronto has to offer.

With hundreds of major employers and thousands of restaurants and shopping options within walking distance, this short-term rental offers both convenience and ambiance.

 (Hidden by Airbnb) , (Hidden by Airbnb) , AirBnB, and Salesforce have sales offices here, and tech companies near central Toronto include Pivotal, Connected Lab, Shopify, MyPlanet, 500Px, Influitive, EventMobi, Freshbooks, and Wattpad.
Travel nurses and doctors or patients from other cities can easily reach St. Michaels Hospital, The Hospital for Sick Children, Toronto General Hospital, Women’s College Hospital, and Toronto Western Hospital.
If city business brings you here, Toronto City Hall is a seven-minute walk. The Toronto Stock Exchange is the ninth largest stock exchange in the world. Finance is also a major economic driver with the Royal Bank of Canada, the Bank of Nova Scotia, Toronto Dominion Bank, and the Bank of Montreal all based here.
Osgood Hall and court houses at 361 University Ave., are within 5 minutes walking distance.
Canada Opera House, Sheraton Center and many other points of interest are within your most convenient reach.

This one-bedroom executive rental is CHBO Certified and offers you the best of everything.
At QWEST you’re greeted by an elegantly appointed lobby of marble, tile, and glass.
Inside the unit you have high-end furnishings of neutral beige and brown which compliments the blonde hardwood floors under spotlights. The open floor plan consists of living, dining, and kitchen in a long main living space. There’s a big screen Samsung ready for your shows, high speed Wi-Fi to entertain and inform, and a four-seat dining area perfect for friends. A kitchen of granite counters and matching new black appliances combines with all the tools and utensils for you to cook every night if you wish. A huge king bed of ultra-soft linens and a wall mounted flat screen TV is the perfect spot to indulge or get some rest. There is track lighting, a full closet, and it is just across from the full bathroom with a shower and tub combination. You also have a stacked washer and dryer combination, so it’s just a few steps to get your laundry done. There is underground visitor parking available for free for your guests or for you to park during the day. if you need overnight parking, please contact our office. Extra charges might apply.

A perfect 100 walk score means forget renting or buying a car. Get a bird’s eye view at CN Tower along the shoreline of Lake Ontario, have a seat at the retractable roofed Rogers Centre, home to baseball’s Toronto Blue Jays and Toronto Argonauts of the CFL, or tour Ripley’s Aquarium of Canada - all a 13-minute stroll away in the entertainment district. Hundreds of great restaurants of all cuisines are walkable from QWEST, along with bars and jazz clubs, museums, art galleries, and more. Hockey fans are in heaven here as well, it’s a 15-minute walk to see the Maple Leafs at the Air Canada Centre and even closer to the Hockey Hall of Fame. Or, get away from the hustle of downtown at one of a dozen city parks in walking distance from QWEST. At the end of the day, have a cocktail at Harbourfront Centre on the shore of the lake or charter a boat out onto the lake, and revel in all Toronto has to offer.

host_about:
I'm a freelancer who enjoys traveling, dancing and people.

Born in Beijing, raised in Montreal, I lived in Toronto, and now Vancouver.

Interests
World cultures, people & psychology, literature, a good corner coffee shop, writing, Chinese culture and arts, exploring off the beaten path, street food or finer delicacies, French pastries, dancing, stimulating conversations, creative and analytical people, photography, immersing in local culture, flea markets, holistic medicine, lifelong learning and growing.

Most Memorable Travel Moments:
- Looking over the cliffs of the Zhang Jia Jie mountains (Avatar movie), China
- Listening to live salsa music and dancing with musician friends in Casa de la Musica, Cuba
- Watching a beaver swim in the pristine lake in the interior of Algonquin park, Ontario
- Eating meat on a stick and drinking beer with friends in Beijing hutongs
- Cycling 300 km between mountain and ocean along the East coast of Taiwan 
- Crinkling smiling eyes of friends and strangers all over the world

Stepping into a person's home is special: a space someone spent vital energy building, decorating, living in, making their own over the years. It's as close as you can possibly get to the place you are visiting. 

I look forward to meeting all fellow Airbnbers!

host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. I've also been complimented on my knack for home design and couple that with being slightly OCD and my years of landlord experience, I feel I'm able to provide the settings that I have always loved and remembered in my own personal travels. I have moved into a very large home right across from Woodbine Beach where I have already had very positive hosting experiences right from the get-go! 

The location, home and decor is not only premium but I pay careful attention to detail is what I hope will resonate with my guests. My friends and family have referred to my new home as the Bougie Beach House and that has been coined as one of Toronto's best beach AirBnB's!

host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. I've also been complimented on my knack for home design and couple that with being slightly OCD and my years of landlord experience, I feel I'm able to provide the settings that I have always loved and remembered in my own personal travels. I have moved into a very large home right across from Woodbine Beach where I have already had very positive hosting experiences right from the get-go! 

The location, home and decor is not only premium but I pay careful attention to detail is what I hope will resonate with my guests. My friends and family have referred to my new home as the Bougie Beach House and that has been coined as one of Toronto's best beach AirBnB's!

Whether you are visiting Toronto to study, work, or explore. I think our home is a great fit for just about anybody. If you enjoying going out for dinner, drinks, movies, or playing volleyball out the beach, please drop us a line. We're often out and about doing fun things.

Here's a little more about us:
Shanny & I met while I was studying in Canada, and we met playing Tennis. Together, we explored Toronto, and discovered some really great places. We are a couple of avid touring cyclists, movie lovers, and foodies who love to host and accommodate travelers and students from around the world. We have both lived, and traveled to countries such as Thailand, Germany, Sri-Lanka, Japan, Guam, Korea, and to most countries in Europe. We love getting to know our guests, and have made some really great friends, and have hosted on Airbnb since day one. 

When we travel we love to just jump on a plane and go without a plan. Something crazy that we've done is ride our bicycles across the full length of Japan 2500+ km over the course of 1 month. Adventure is something that defines us, and we strongly believe that the world is too beautiful to be left undiscovered! 

If you need any help discovering Toronto or any assistance while here, just let us know. We'll try our best to help accommodate you. ;)

Seiko & Shanny

host_about:
Whether you are visiting Toronto to study, work, or explore. I think our home is a great fit for just about anybody. If you enjoying going out for dinner, drinks, movies, or playing volleyball out the beach, please drop us a line. We're often out and about doing fun things.

Here's a little more about us:
Shanny & I met while I was studying in Canada, and we met playing Tennis. Together, we explored Toronto, and discovered some really great places. We are a couple of avid touring cyclists, movie lovers, and foodies who love to host and accommodate travelers and students from around the world. We have both lived, and traveled to countries such as Thailand, Germany, Sri-Lanka, Japan, Guam, Korea, and to most countries in Europe. We love getting to know our guests, and have made some really great friends, and have hosted on Airbnb since day one. 

When we travel we love to just jump on a plane and go without a plan. Something crazy that we've done is ride our bicycles across the full length of Japan 2500+ km over the course of 1 month. Adventure is something that defines us, and we strongly believe that the world is too beautiful to be left undiscovered! 

If you need any help discovering Toronto or any assistance while here, just let us know. We'll try our best to help accommodate you. ;)

Seiko & Shanny

host_about:
I am a York University and James Cook University Alumni. I have a BA in Social Science and a Graduate Diploma in Primary/Junior Education. I am currently working for the Toronto District School Board as an Elementary School Teacher. I am happily married to my wife Veenuja, who works as an IT Analyst for a downtown firm here in Toronto. We have 2 little girls who keep us very busy. 

I was born in Sri Lanka, grew up in Germany, studied in Australia, and have been calling Canada "home" for the last 25 years. Throughout my life I have traveled to many countries and have met some wonderful friends all over.  

My parents hosted guests on AirBnB while my wife and I were living with them. My wife Veenu and I had the opportunity to meet some really cool people through AirBnB. Now that I am living with my wife in my own spacious house, we want to open up our home to AirBnB and continue to meet people from all over the world while providing them with friendly and reliable accommodations.

My wife and I love going out to eat, watching netflix, and having a drink outside with our friends. After work, my wife and I usually binge watch a series like The Walking Dead or Game of Thrones. One thing I can't live without is sports. I watch basketball and soccer religiously. I'm a huge fan of the Toronto Raptors. I mostly play basketball, soccer, volleyball and just about watch anything sports related on TV. My wife and I are big sushi fans and love going to All You Can Eat Sushi restaurants. Besides stuffing our faces with delicious food, we also love to travel. Warm tropical destinations are our favourites. The best thing about travelling is getting to know the local culture and history. We are very social and have made a lot of friends through AirBnB. We always enjoy learning about other cultures and sharing our own.

We want to make sure you are in good spirits and well taken care of when you are with us. Most of the times my dad helps me out in running the Airbnb at the house when I’m not available.

host_about:
Whether you are visiting Toronto to study, work, or explore. I think our home is a great fit for just about anybody. If you enjoying going out for dinner, drinks, movies, or playing volleyball out the beach, please drop us a line. We're often out and about doing fun things.

Here's a little more about us:
Shanny & I met while I was studying in Canada, and we met playing Tennis. Together, we explored Toronto, and discovered some really great places. We are a couple of avid touring cyclists, movie lovers, and foodies who love to host and accommodate travelers and students from around the world. We have both lived, and traveled to countries such as Thailand, Germany, Sri-Lanka, Japan, Guam, Korea, and to most countries in Europe. We love getting to know our guests, and have made some really great friends, and have hosted on Airbnb since day one. 

When we travel we love to just jump on a plane and go without a plan. Something crazy that we've done is ride our bicycles across the full length of Japan 2500+ km over the course of 1 month. Adventure is something that defines us, and we strongly believe that the world is too beautiful to be left undiscovered! 

If you need any help discovering Toronto or any assistance while here, just let us know. We'll try our best to help accommodate you. ;)

Seiko & Shanny

host_about:
I am a York University and James Cook University Alumni. I have a BA in Social Science and a Graduate Diploma in Primary/Junior Education. I am currently working for the Toronto District School Board as an Elementary School Teacher. I am happily married to my wife Veenuja, who works as an IT Analyst for a downtown firm here in Toronto. We have 2 little girls who keep us very busy. 

I was born in Sri Lanka, grew up in Germany, studied in Australia, and have been calling Canada "home" for the last 25 years. Throughout my life I have traveled to many countries and have met some wonderful friends all over.  

My parents hosted guests on AirBnB while my wife and I were living with them. My wife Veenu and I had the opportunity to meet some really cool people through AirBnB. Now that I am living with my wife in my own spacious house, we want to open up our home to AirBnB and continue to meet people from all over the world while providing them with friendly and reliable accommodations.

My wife and I love going out to eat, watching netflix, and having a drink outside with our friends. After work, my wife and I usually binge watch a series like The Walking Dead or Game of Thrones. One thing I can't live without is sports. I watch basketball and soccer religiously. I'm a huge fan of the Toronto Raptors. I mostly play basketball, soccer, volleyball and just about watch anything sports related on TV. My wife and I are big sushi fans and love going to All You Can Eat Sushi restaurants. Besides stuffing our faces with delicious food, we also love to travel. Warm tropical destinations are our favourites. The best thing about travelling is getting to know the local culture and history. We are very social and have made a lot of friends through AirBnB. We always enjoy learning about other cultures and sharing our own.

We want to make sure you are in good spirits and well taken care of when you are with us. Most of the times my dad helps me out in running the Airbnb at the house when I’m not available.

Whether you are visiting Toronto to study, work, or explore. I think our home is a great fit for just about anybody. If you enjoying going out for dinner, drinks, movies, or playing volleyball out the beach, please drop us a line. We're often out and about doing fun things.

Here's a little more about us:
Shanny & I met while I was studying in Canada, and we met playing Tennis. Together, we explored Toronto, and discovered some really great places. We are a couple of avid touring cyclists, movie lovers, and foodies who love to host and accommodate travelers and students from around the world. We love getting to know our guests, and have made some really great friends, and have hosted on Airbnb since day one.

Adventure is something that defines us, and we strongly believe that the world is too beautiful to be left undiscovered! 

If you need any help discovering Toronto or any assistance while here, just let us know. We'll try our best to help accommodate you. ;)

Seiko & Shanny

host_about:
My wife says I am a workaholic.  But I do have three passions outside of family. 

One is to travel.  While I doubt I will ever retire, my goal is to start slowing down.  Take one month trips at least once per year.  And extended weekends at least once every three months.  Our last trip was a 5 day venture to Agawa Canyon to see the fall colours.  We both loved it, not just the train ride but the drive.  Weather was gorgeous the first two days so we had the top down.  The last day we stayed in Bracebridge and agreed we must go back sometime soon.

A second is farming.  We live on a 12 acre hobby farm.  I have researched growing techniques and for us, regenerative farming is the answer.  Regenerative farming is all about feeding the soil life.  Truly amazing what goes on in the ground that we never see.  In supporting soil life and the growing of nutritious foods we follow 3 simple principles.  1) We minimize soil disturbance and avoid tillage at all costs.  2) We never use any chemicals.  No fertilizers, no pesticides, and no herbicides.  Not even organic chemicals are used.  3) Roots in the ground.  Always.  Or the soil is covered.

In future I hope to start leaving care packages for all our guests.  A small sampling of our produce.  And those who like our food can order more.

My third passion is running.  I have run two Half Marathon's and hope to run a third soon.

host_about:
I Scott, have an avid interest in art & design, and theatre and dance. I also love sailing, snowboarding, staying in shape, talking about social issues, peace and mindfulness. I studied advertising design and psychology-sociology in university and did communications design for many years as a career. For years I've also been involved as a volunteer helping others through non-profit organizations. 

I Deb, am an avid fitness buff who loves going to the gym several times a week and walking. I’ve been in the cosmetics industry for most of my life and people see me as very sociable, caring, positive and happy. 

We both love to travel and see other parts of the world and learn about other cultures and how they live. We also love food and cooking, and film and music of many genres.

We are people-persons and enjoy making new friends and making others feel respected and cared for. We value social awareness, and being open to the uniqueness of every person. We avidly support equal rights and inclusiveness in terms or race, culture, ethnicity, gender identity and sexual orientation, and hope that all guests of ours feel the same.

Staying at our place will feel comfortable and relaxed, in a lived in atmosphere with 1 full time renter and 3 other Airbnb rooms/guests when all rooms are booked, all of whom are free to use the kitchen, laundry and living room with tv and fireplace. The neighbourhood is safe with most residents being made up of young professionals, and families. 

Our place is a 25 minute transit ride to downtown, a 15 minute drive to Pearson Airport, a 4 minute walk to the lake (and even less to the huge and beautiful High Park), and a 2 minute walk to St. Joseph's hospital in the popular area of Toronto known as Roncesvalles Village. Here there are many food markets, boutique shops, restaurants, cafes and sports bars, some with live entertainment many nights of the week.

We strive for, and hope that your stay here will be an enjoyable one.

host_about:
I am a York University and James Cook University Alumni. I have a BA in Social Science and a Graduate Diploma in Primary/Junior Education. I am currently working for the Toronto District School Board as an Elementary School Teacher. I am happily married to my wife Veenuja, who works as an IT Analyst for a downtown firm here in Toronto. We have 2 little girls who keep us very busy. 

I was born in Sri Lanka, grew up in Germany, studied in Australia, and have been calling Canada "home" for the last 25 years. Throughout my life I have traveled to many countries and have met some wonderful friends all over.  

My parents hosted guests on AirBnB while my wife and I were living with them. My wife Veenu and I had the opportunity to meet some really cool people through AirBnB. Now that I am living with my wife in my own spacious house, we want to open up our home to AirBnB and continue to meet people from all over the world while providing them with friendly and reliable accommodations.

My wife and I love going out to eat, watching netflix, and having a drink outside with our friends. After work, my wife and I usually binge watch a series like The Walking Dead or Game of Thrones. One thing I can't live without is sports. I watch basketball and soccer religiously. I'm a huge fan of the Toronto Raptors. I mostly play basketball, soccer, volleyball and just about watch anything sports related on TV. My wife and I are big sushi fans and love going to All You Can Eat Sushi restaurants. Besides stuffing our faces with delicious food, we also love to travel. Warm tropical destinations are our favourites. The best thing about travelling is getting to know the local culture and history. We are very social and have made a lot of friends through AirBnB. We always enjoy learning about other cultures and sharing our own.

We want to make sure you are in good spirits and well taken care of when you are with us. Most of the times my dad helps me out in running the Airbnb at the house when I’m not available.

host_about:
Welcome Students & Travellers, 

A little bit about myself? I love meeting new people because every person you meet will always have a new story to tell and I love listening to them. I enjoy being in the outdoors, such as camping and hiking or relaxing at the cottage. 

What excites me most is traveling and learning about new cultures. My family and I have traveled to near and far countries such as the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, England, Czech Republic, Budapest, Poland, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, Dubai, South Africa, Egypt, and many more places! Being a host allows me to mix all the great things about traveling and meeting new people of different backgrounds together and in the comfort of my own home. I have been a host for 4 years now to many learners and travellers from all around the world coming from Germany, Netherlands, England, Switzerland, Sweden, France, Israel, South Korea, Philippines, Vietnam, Russia Federation, Colombia, and Brazil, just to name a few! 

I must mention, I know a lot of you are moving to Canada for educational purposes, and I would like to say that my home is welcoming to learners. I know what it takes to work hard to achieve excellence and realize dreams. My home is a quiet space, and if any accommodations are needed to assist you in your learning please let me know ahead of time so that arrangements may be made. 

Needless to say, I would be happy to invite you to stay in my home. I have 4 bedrooms each room has a bed, a desk, and lots of closet space. I have 1.5 Gb high-speed internet and Netflix. Also, you would have access to three subway stations from our front door! High Park and Runnymede station take 6 minutes to arrive, where Jane station takes 5 minutes to arrive to from my home. With 30 minutes of travel you can reach English schools, George Brown College, Humber College, Toronto University, York University, and Ryerson University. Please don’t hesitate to ask me any questions! 

Let's always remember life is an adventure. Make new friends, and laugh a lot along the way. 

Hope to meet you soon!

Welcome Students & Travellers, 

A little bit about myself? I love meeting new people because every person you meet will always have a new story to tell and I love listening to them. I enjoy being in the outdoors, such as camping and hiking or relaxing at the cottage. 

What excites me most is traveling and learning about new cultures. My family and I have traveled to near and far countries such as the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, England, Czech Republic, Budapest, Poland, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, Dubai, South Africa, Egypt, and many more places! Being a host allows me to mix all the great things about traveling and meeting new people of different backgrounds together and in the comfort of my own home. I have been a host for 4 years now to many learners and travellers from all around the world coming from Germany, Netherlands, England, Switzerland, Sweden, France, Israel, South Korea, Philippines, Vietnam, Russia Federation, Colombia, and Brazil, just to name a few! 

I must mention, I know a lot of you are moving to Canada for educational purposes, and I would like to say that my home is welcoming to learners. I know what it takes to work hard to achieve excellence and realize dreams. My home is a quiet space, and if any accommodations are needed to assist you in your learning please let me know ahead of time so that arrangements may be made. 

Needless to say, I would be happy to invite you to stay in my home. I have 4 bedrooms each room has a bed, a desk, and lots of closet space. I have 1.5 Gb high-speed internet and Netflix. Also, you would have access to three subway stations from our front door! High Park and Runnymede station take 6 minutes to arrive, where Jane station takes 5 minutes to arrive to from my home. With 30 minutes of travel you can reach English schools, George Brown College, Humber College, Toronto University, York University, and Ryerson University. Please don’t hesitate to ask me any questions! 

Let's always remember life is an adventure. Make new friends, and laugh a lot along the way. 

Hope to meet you soon!

host_about:
Welcome Students & Travellers, 

A little bit about myself? I love meeting new people because every person you meet will always have a new story to tell and I love listening to them. I enjoy being in the outdoors, such as camping and hiking or relaxing at the cottage. 

What excites me most is traveling and learning about new cultures. My family and I have traveled to near and far countries such as the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, England, Czech Republic, Budapest, Poland, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, Dubai, South Africa, Egypt, and many more places! Being a host allows me to mix all the great things about traveling and meeting new people of different backgrounds together and in the comfort of my own home. I have been a host for 4 years now to many learners and travellers from all around the world coming from Germany, Netherlands, England, Switzerland, Sweden, France, Israel, South Korea, Philippines, Vietnam, Russia Federation, Colombia, and Brazil, just to name a few! 

I must mention, I know a lot of you are moving to Canada for educational purposes, and I would like to say that my home is welcoming to learners. I know what it takes to work hard to achieve excellence and realize dreams. My home is a quiet space, and if any accommodations are needed to assist you in your learning please let me know ahead of time so that arrangements may be made. 

Needless to say, I would be happy to invite you to stay in my home. I have 4 bedrooms each room has a bed, a desk, and lots of closet space. I have 1.5 Gb high-speed internet and Netflix. Also, you would have access to three subway stations from our front door! High Park and Runnymede station take 6 minutes to arrive, where Jane station takes 5 minutes to arrive to from my home. With 30 minutes of travel you can reach English schools, George Brown College, Humber College, Toronto University, York University, and Ryerson University. Please don’t hesitate to ask me any questions! 

Let's always remember life is an adventure. Make new friends, and laugh a lot along the way. 

Hope to meet you soon!

Please don’t hesitate to ask me any questions! 

Let's always remember life is an adventure. Make new friends, and laugh a lot along the way. 

Hope to meet you soon!

host_about:
I love creating large, bright environments where people can be PRESENT and explore the arts. I'm a sensitive, spiritual romantic with a double dose of imagination. A generalist, builder, entrepreneur and live solidly by the 80/20 rules of life engagement. 
I'm also moody, stubborn and cannot be found in the month of July. 

Professionally I'm an Experience Designer - specializing in local food systems and curating food-driven experiences. This spans;
Restaurants, Festivals, Underground Experiences, Weddings (only special ones) and Pop-up Whatevers in the woods somewhere. 

Mad for the written word, the big picture, and my Akita, Chloe. 
I've been a local food advocate since working (well mostly surfing) in Tofino, BC in the 90's. 
I'm from Kitchener, Ontario - and have lived in Oaxaca, Sayulita, BC, Newfoundland, New York, Toronto and now Prince Edward County, ON. My goal is to live by the water, on a big piece of land and create a prospector tent 'outdoor camp & accommodation where groups can create 3day feasts, and come connect to nature, each other and themselves. 

Nothing stirs my soul more than a poetic novel, a good swim in a clean body of water, kitchen parties, bonfires, historic ruins or a wildly inventive adventures. 

The House is where I sleep & eat for a month post some life-capade 
or 
come home for a season and invite the city over. It somehow, magically, is quiet and still when you need it to be and a magnet for up and coming talent in my industry at others. We're always experimenting, pickling or brewing something around here.  I host both Chefs and Artists-In-Residence to support the growing need for their incubation in large inspiring space. 

The shelves are full of my travels, grandpa's science equipment, cookbooks and ever present reminders of the west coast. 

The House as life I suppose is meant for exploration. 

9 Things I Can't Live Without...
 
good coffee
Chloe the wolf
sky & water & woods (equally) 
my oversize sketch book 
time to daydream 
spirit-adventures 
Into The Deep (a painting Nicholas Peat) 
my long walnut harvest table
and maple syrup



I think it's important to find physical spaces in the city that belong to you.

We clean up after ourselves and leave places the way we found them or tidier, whether it is a camp site, our extended family's lakefront cottage, or someone's home we are privileged to visit.

As a family we have lived in Washington DC, Berkeley CA, and now Toronto.  We love to take advantage of all the museums and diverse cultures (especially the food!) that have been on our doorstep in DC, SF, and now Toronto.

All of us play a musical instrument and participate in sports or dance. My favorite museum in the world is the V&A in London, and my favorite trumpet player is Clifford Brown.

host_about:
I love creating large, bright environments where people can be PRESENT and explore the arts. I'm a sensitive, spiritual romantic with a double dose of imagination. A generalist, builder, entrepreneur and live solidly by the 80/20 rules of life engagement. 
I'm also moody, stubborn and cannot be found in the month of July. 

Professionally I'm an Experience Designer - specializing in local food systems and curating food-driven experiences. This spans;
Restaurants, Festivals, Underground Experiences, Weddings (only special ones) and Pop-up Whatevers in the woods somewhere. 

Mad for the written word, the big picture, and my Akita, Chloe. 
I've been a local food advocate since working (well mostly surfing) in Tofino, BC in the 90's. 
I'm from Kitchener, Ontario - and have lived in Oaxaca, Sayulita, BC, Newfoundland, New York, Toronto and now Prince Edward County, ON. My goal is to live by the water, on a big piece of land and create a prospector tent 'outdoor camp & accommodation where groups can create 3day feasts, and come connect to nature, each other and themselves. 

Nothing stirs my soul more than a poetic novel, a good swim in a clean body of water, kitchen parties, bonfires, historic ruins or a wildly inventive adventures. 

The House is where I sleep & eat for a month post some life-capade 
or 
come home for a season and invite the city over. It somehow, magically, is quiet and still when you need it to be and a magnet for up and coming talent in my industry at others. We're always experimenting, pickling or brewing something around here.  I host both Chefs and Artists-In-Residence to support the growing need for their incubation in large inspiring space. 

The shelves are full of my travels, grandpa's science equipment, cookbooks and ever present reminders of the west coast. 

The House as life I suppose is meant for exploration. 

9 Things I Can't Live Without...
 
good coffee
Chloe the wolf
sky & water & woods (equally) 
my oversize sketch book 
time to daydream 
spirit-adventures 
Into The Deep (a painting Nicholas Peat) 
my long walnut harvest table
and maple syrup



I think it's important to find physical spaces in the city that belong to you.  
You know, places to go on Mondays when you fake sick to work - or when visiting to recharge or renew your esprit. Your Secret Toronto (or wherever you are from) 
Top of my list:
Gallery Italia at the AGO, on a sunny day in March preferably. It submerges you with the high light of the city. The bustle of Dundas street rendered silent through all that curved glass. Sitting among the big trees feels like a privilege here. You can savour the rare feeling of being grounded, 4 stories up.

Also High Park...any day / weather of the week. No traffic noise, complex nature, that smell of sandy soil and conifers...gets me everytime

What are you doing to do with this, your one Wild and Precious Life? -mary oliver

Nothing stirs my soul more than a poetic novel, a good swim in a clean body of water, kitchen parties, bonfires, historic ruins or a wildly inventive adventures.

or 
come home for a season and invite the city over. It somehow, magically, is quiet and still when you need it to be and a magnet for up and coming talent in my industry at others. We're always experimenting, pickling or brewing something around here.  I host both Chefs and Artists-In-Residence to support the growing need for their incubation in large inspiring space. 

The shelves are full of my travels, grandpa's science equipment, cookbooks and ever present reminders of the west coast. 

The House as life I suppose is meant for exploration. 

9 Things I Can't Live Without...
 
good coffee
Chloe the wolf
sky & water & woods (equally) 
my oversize sketch book 
time to daydream 
spirit-adventures 
Into The Deep (a painting Nicholas Peat) 
my long walnut harvest table
and maple syrup



I think it's important to find physical spaces in the city that belong to you.  
You know, places to go on Mondays when you fake sick to work - or when visiting to recharge or renew your esprit. Your Secret Toronto (or wherever you are from) 
Top of my list:
Gallery Italia at the AGO, on a sunny day in March preferably. It submerges you with the high light of the city. The bustle of Dundas street rendered silent through all that curved glass. Sitting among the big trees feels like a privilege here. You can savour the rare feeling of being grounded, 4 stories up.

Also High Park...any day / weather of the week. No traffic noise, complex nature, that smell of sandy soil and conifers...gets me everytime

What are you doing to do with this, your one Wild and Precious Life? -mary oliver

Hello Guests & Welcome!
I would love to welcome you in our home!
I am so glad and excited to be a part of Airbnb Community, and to be able to help travelers/guests feel right at home!
Adelaida's-Airbnb Profile:
I started hosting on Airbnb in 2016. I became an Airbnb host because I love meeting new people from all over the world. Also, I listed my home on Airbnb because I want to connect with people from other cultures.  After a year,  I became a Superhost.  I really enjoy providing my guests with the best experience possible. I live on-site and I am available if they need anything. 
My hobbies are sports, and I also like to cook.  I share my dishes with my guests every time I have extra food.  I have compassion to help people when they need help and sharing experiences and stories.
I like to travel around the world – Spain, US, Italy, Jerusalem & other beautiful places.
I had my degree of  Bachelor of  Commerce with a major in Business Management in MLQU University.
I have also completed a Certificate of Library Science. I studied at Centennial College, Toronto, Ontario and received a Certificate from the  Paralegal & Law Clerk Program.
I worked in a Law Firm for more than 15 years as a Legal Researcher at Castillo Laman Tan Pantaleon & San Jose Law Offices in Makati City. 
We migrated to Canada in January 2000 and I was hired in Centennial College, Centre of Entrepreneurship as an Administrative Coordinator.  After working in this Department for more than 16 years, I was transferred to the Assessment Centre as an Office Administrator.
I have also experienced in preparing legal papers to help people, if they cannot afford to hire a lawyer - such as affidavits, contracts and forms for divorce to file to the Family Court!

host_about:
I Scott, have an avid interest in art & design, and theatre and dance. I also love sailing, snowboarding, staying in shape, talking about social issues, peace and mindfulness. I studied advertising design and psychology-sociology in university and did communications design for many years as a career. For years I've also been involved as a volunteer helping others through non-profit organizations. 

I Deb, am an avid fitness buff who loves going to the gym several times a week and walking. I’ve been in the cosmetics industry for most of my life and people see me as very sociable, caring, positive and happy. 

We both love to travel and see other parts of the world and learn about other cultures and how they live. We also love food and cooking, and film and music of many genres.

We are people-persons and enjoy making new friends and making others feel respected and cared for. We value social awareness, and being open to the uniqueness of every person. We avidly support equal rights and inclusiveness in terms or race, culture, ethnicity, gender identity and sexual orientation, and hope that all guests of ours feel the same.

Staying at our place will feel comfortable and relaxed, in a lived in atmosphere with 1 full time renter and 3 other Airbnb rooms/guests when all rooms are booked, all of whom are free to use the kitchen, laundry and living room with tv and fireplace. The neighbourhood is safe with most residents being made up of young professionals, and families. 

Our place is a 25 minute transit ride to downtown, a 15 minute drive to Pearson Airport, a 4 minute walk to the lake (and even less to the huge and beautiful High Park), and a 2 minute walk to St. Joseph's hospital in the popular area of Toronto known as Roncesvalles Village. Here there are many food markets, boutique shops, restaurants, cafes and sports bars, some with live entertainment many nights of the week.

We strive for, and hope that your stay here will be an enjoyable one.

Hello Guests & Welcome!
I would love to welcome you in our home!
I am so glad and excited to be a part of Airbnb Community, and to be able to help travelers/guests feel right at home!
Adelaida's-Airbnb Profile:
I started hosting on Airbnb in 2016. I became an Airbnb host because I love meeting new people from all over the world. Also, I listed my home on Airbnb because I want to connect with people from other cultures.  After a year,  I became a Superhost.  I really enjoy providing my guests with the best experience possible. I live on-site and I am available if they need anything. 
My hobbies are sports, and I also like to cook.  I share my dishes with my guests every time I have extra food.  I have compassion to help people when they need help and sharing experiences and stories.
I like to travel around the world – Spain, US, Italy, Jerusalem & other beautiful places.
I had my degree of  Bachelor of  Commerce with a major in Business Management in MLQU University.
I have also completed a Certificate of Library Science. I studied at Centennial College, Toronto, Ontario and received a Certificate from the  Paralegal & Law Clerk Program.
I worked in a Law Firm for more than 15 years as a Legal Researcher at Castillo Laman Tan Pantaleon & San Jose Law Offices in Makati City. 
We migrated to Canada in January 2000 and I was hired in Centennial College, Centre of Entrepreneurship as an Administrative Coordinator.  After working in this Department for more than 16 years, I was transferred to the Assessment Centre as an Office Administrator.
I have also experienced in preparing legal papers to help people, if they cannot afford to hire a lawyer - such as affidavits, contracts and forms for divorce to file to the Family Court!

Hey, I'm Carlos. I love traveling! I started traveling on my own when I was 15. I hitch-hiked from Toronto to Montréal with $5.00 in my pocket for a week. It was a project created by a buddy and myself. We each returned with 75 cents.

I've slept on University grounds, on strangers' floors and in youth hostels. I've also stayed in villas with private swimming pools in Saint Bart's and the Amalfi Coast. 

There's nothing better than seeing the world and meeting people from different cultures than your own. I've always appreciated that our best memories of a place are linked to the people we've met there.

I'm a self employed musician and a film and television composer. Through that work I've been fortunate enough to combine two of my favourite passions; music and travel.

“Our battered suitcases were piled on the sidewalk again; we had longer ways to go. But no matter, the road is life.” – Jack Kerouac

My wife and I have traveled together to Hawaii, Mexico, Costa Rica, France, San Francisco, LA, New York, New Orleans, Québec City. She has lived in Barcelona and we both speak English, Spanish and French. 

“Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness.” – Mark Twain

host_about:
I built this B & B with the wish to share a nature sanctuary with others who love to live in the beauty a conservation area offers, and enjoy the wealth of culture and arts here in Toronto.  Even though you are in nature, this B & B is in the city; only a 12 minute walk from the subway. Your view from your glass balcony, aptly named the "Tree House" room is of the ravine!  I also offer Yoga Classes, Yoga and Dance, Meditation, Thai Massage (I studied in Thailand) and mindfulness classes. This means my guests can use have a Thai Massage, Yoga class or Meditation class (depending on which day they arrive) when they feel the need.  I am a Registered Health Care provider with the College of Kinesiology, and this means I offer exercise prescription and healthful consultations that may be covered by your healthcare plan.  I work with people of all needs including those with MS. and post cardiac events, stroke and motor vehicle accidents.

There are group Yoga classes six days a week, or guests can book their own private session (Partner Yoga anyone?)    The meals are healthy, organic, and can be raw, gluten free, sugar free and meat free, if you like. No judgment, if you want a big juicy steak, you will be provided for!  Also, if you really want to kick back with some red wine and popcorn for a movie, then you will be in the right place.  My home, Yoga studio and lifestyle are considered super healthy, yet I am not a moralistic person, I wish for all my guests to live their own version of inspired living.   I just really want you to know, that every person that walks into the Yoga House, either for a Yoga class or to stay in the B & B "gets it" -- they feel the incredible vibe in this place that drops them into their own sense of peaceful and joyful self.  When I see this, it makes me very, very happy.

All of our listings are comprised of our previous experiences and knowledge.
